entities.name: Levi ben Abraham ben Hayyim
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Rabbi Levi ben Abraham ben Hayyim was a French encyclopedist; champion of the liberal party in Provence in the struggle for the study of secular sciences; born at Villefranche-de-Conflent, Roussillon, between 1240 and 1250; died at or near Arles soon after 1315.
